description: Create an asymmetric original Grid arena, connect a new start to its native bot route, play the unsaved draft, then return to the original route with undo and redo intact.

required_lines: LEVELTOOL\.ROOMS: length=2100 width=1800 height=600 members=6 second_length=2700 doorway_width=500\.00 doorway_height=390\.00

required_sequences.name: A playtest uses the added route and returns to the original native route
patterns: SMOKE\.GRID\.ROUTE: phase=original pads=8 waypoints=8 waygroups=1 edges=8 first_hop=-1
SMOKE\.GRID\.ROUTE: connected spawn=spawn_[0-9]+ pad=pad_0008 target=pad_0000 path=path_0001 position=

SCENARIO\.SOURCE: generated deterministic navigation tables from public pads\.json '[^']*grid_connect_pads[^']*' and navigation/paths\.json '[^']*' .* as 9 waypoints, 1 waygroups, 9 covers, 9 path edges, 1 branch waypoints
SMOKE\.GRID\.ROUTE: phase=draft pads=9 waypoints=9 waygroups=1 edges=9 first_hop=0
SMOKE\.GRID\.ROUTE: phase=returned pads=8 waypoints=8 waygroups=1 edges=8 first_hop=-1
SMOKE\.GRID\.ROUTE: returned with linked draft history=retained
